disposition: No supported 2.3.9 declaration resolves all eight boundaries. Preserve current refusal, implement and qualify framework-owned corrections/extensions. A new distinct maintenance release is necessary IF these changes ship before 2.5; exact version not reserved or publication authorized by this memo. 2.3.9 remains immutable. Tuple correction alone does not unblock SDK Standard3.

capabilities.route: Builtin descriptor identity and separate getter entrypoints; retain source getter body/effects. Name-only property allowlist is unsound.
capabilities.negative_boundary: Shadowed builtin, custom decorators, setters/deleters, descriptor/inheritance or rebinding ambiguity refuse.

capabilities.route: Resolve source-proven class and cooperative MRO; explicit builtin exception local-state effect model where provable. Keep unknown cooperative dispatch hard.
capabilities.negative_boundary: Multiple/dynamic bases, custom overrides, shadowed super and unaccounted args/state effects refuse.

capabilities.route: Distinguish value dependency from receiver identity; current ast.walk origins taint response/data with self when obtained through self.field. Need exact assignment/return/value provenance and category-specific external ports.
capabilities.negative_boundary: Never mark all aliases eligible; ambiguous branches/rebinding/custom receiver effects refuse; annotations alone insufficient.

capabilities.route: Record actual cls call as class-bound construction with receiver/subclass provenance; do not assert statically exact canonical class for arbitrary subclass dispatch.
capabilities.negative_boundary: Rebound/shadowed/escaped cls, unknown target and unaccounted normalization refuse.

capabilities.route: Current covered=owner_discovered and bool(actual construction facts) has no external-library witness path. Add explicit externally callable construction responsibility with independently verified public API/consumer witness; keep constructor_count=0 truthful.
capabilities.negative_boundary: No fake calls, extra test roots, report-only downgrade or automatic zero-count acceptance.

capabilities.route: Inventory nested functions with lexical qualified identities; separate factory creation from deferred body calls/effects and connect actual callback invocation/field sink witnesses.
capabilities.negative_boundary: Do not flatten or treat factory invocation as callback execution; unknown escape/alias/async effect remains unresolved.

capabilities.route: Recursive tuple/list/starred/delete target traversal in existing visitor; reuse current rebinding/effect guard. Source-only patch+12 authored cases ready.
capabilities.negative_boundary: Every method target retained; exact-other receiver stays distinct; existing unresolved dispatch is not relaxed.

capabilities.route: Existing permitted_defaults_and_single_application_point entries name field,value,owner; authorized constructors/factories and hostile_boundary_decoder name distinct paths. These declarations do not currently establish path-sensitive single-application correctness. Preserve direct constructor defaults vs explicit decoded values; extend native conformance if required.
capabilities.negative_boundary: No empty defaults interpreted as absence, no tuple helper relabeled canonical owner, no DTO construction conferred token authority.

first_slice.mirrors: Both authored producer and managed runtime source patched identically; regenerated pack projection still required after application.
first_slice.qualification: Recovery scheduled exact official-base candidate, retain baseline/red and healthy/negative/restored controls; all existing method/semantic tests and source mirrors, typing/lint then required full native gates. Actual SDK reacquisition and complete original20+semantic21/337 required; no filtered facts or tests.

source_custody: No existing project/source/env/shared Git state mutated. Source-only owner staging; proposed isolated branch maintenance/sdk-native-compatibility after Recovery schedules exact source assembly. Existing main/dirty deferred work and 2.5 unaffected.
retirement: Owner staging remains needed through decision/application/qualification; archive unique draft or retain committed reachable refs before retiring after merge.
